releaseNotes:
Notes v1.8.14 (Build 186):
• Realistic hugging animation for 🤗 and 🫂 emojis: hands and arms wrap around in a warm, tight embrace and squeeze instead of bursting hearts
• Video notes powered by ExoPlayer with smooth inline silent playback
• Material 3 date & time pickers across chat schedule, search jump, and check-after
• Categorized Settings & Privacy pages (Account, Privacy, Chats, Notifications, Calls, Storage)
